ObstaclePanel.authorObstaclesAndPushThemTo: Author obstacles and push them to the FC as exclusion fences
ObstaclePanel.uploadObstaclesAsExclusionFencesAnd: Upload obstacles as exclusion fences and enable avoidance + path planning
ObstaclePanel.clearAllFencesOnTheFlight: Clear all fences on the flight controller

SimStreamControl.publishThe3dViewAsAn: Publish the 3D view as an RTSP stream for OpenCV, VLC or ffmpeg

SimTestPanel.rehearseAFlightInjectMotorFaults: Rehearse a flight: inject motor faults, payload, wind, GPS/nav and sensor failures
SimTestPanel.ardudeckPhysicsEngineIsDrivingThe: STOHID physics engine is driving the sim: motors, wind and payload are set live
SimTestPanel.builtInArdupilotSitlPhysicsConditions: Built-in ArduPilot SITL physics: conditions set via SIM_* parameters
SimTestPanel.restoreAllConditionsToSafeDefaults: Restore all conditions to safe defaults
SimTestPanel.clickAnArmToFailThat: Click an arm to fail that motor. Live faults are echoed from the engine.
SimTestPanel.howBadTheNextInjectedFault: How bad the next injected fault is (0-100%)
SimTestPanel.remainingThrustOnFailedMotorsSim: Remaining thrust on failed motors (SIM_ENGINE_MUL): 0% = dead, else partial loss
SimTestPanel.attachOrUpdateASlungLoad: Attach (or update) a slung load on a cable below the aircraft
SimTestPanel.packVoltageSimBattVoltageDrop: Pack voltage (SIM_BATT_VOLTAGE) - drop toward the failsafe threshold to test low-battery actions
SimTestPanel.injectAHorizontalPositionOffsetSim: Inject a horizontal position offset (SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_X/Y) to test glitch rejection / flyaway
SimTestPanel.reportedSatelliteCountSimGps1Numsats: Reported satellite count (SIM_GPS1_NUMSATS); drop below the arming minimum to degrade the fix
SimTestPanel.motorDrivenVibrationAmplitudeSimVib: Motor-driven vibration amplitude (SIM_VIB_MOT_MAX, m/s/s) - high values clip the IMU
SimTestPanel.waitingForTheMotorLayoutFrom: Waiting for the motor layout from the engine (
SimTestPanel.payOutTheWinchLowerThe: Pay out the winch (lower the load)
SimTestPanel.reelInTheWinchRaiseThe: Reel in the winch (raise the load)
SimTestPanel.disableToTestTheGpsLoss: Disable to test the GPS-loss failsafe / EKF fallback (SIM_GPS1_ENABLE)
SimTestPanel.dropRcToTriggerTheRadio: Drop RC to trigger the radio failsafe (SIM_RC_FAIL)

SimWorldView.followBehindTheVehicleAlongIts: Follow behind the vehicle along its heading
SimWorldView.dragToOrbitScrollToZoom: Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom
SimWorldView.terrainNeedsAGpsOriginWait: Terrain needs a GPS origin - wait for a position fix
SimWorldView.terrainElevationFetchFailedCheckThe: Terrain elevation fetch failed - check the network and retry
SimWorldView.showRealElevationTerrainSyntheticVision: Show real elevation terrain (synthetic vision) under the vehicles
SimWorldView.sharedWithSyntheticVisionTheGround: Shared with synthetic vision. The ground nearest the vehicle always uses the sharpest imagery.
SimWorldView.physicsXRayForceBudgetThrough: Physics X-ray: force budget through the CG (thrust, weight, drag, net resultant), per-motor arrows, CG markers and g-load (STOHID sim engine only)
SimWorldView.referenceGridASpatialPerceptionAid: Reference grid: a spatial-perception aid that stays visible over both the flat ground and the SVT terrain
SimWorldView.conformal3dWaypointMarkersTargetReticles: Conformal 3D waypoint markers: target reticles floating at each waypoint's true position + altitude, with number and live slant-range
SimWorldView.fpvHudOverlayBoresightPitchRoll: FPV HUD overlay: boresight, pitch/roll horizon ladder, airspeed/altitude, heading and climb rate (FPV & Chase views)
SimWorldView.hudIsOnlyAvailableInFpv: HUD is only available in FPV & Chase views
SimWorldView.theVehicleWillAppearHereOnce: The vehicle will appear here once it has a position fix. Any connected SITL or aircraft works. The STOHID sim engine is optional.
SimWorldView.connectToSitlOrAVehicle: Connect to SITL (or a vehicle) from the main window and it will appear here.
SimWorldView.multiVehicleOpsRunOverThe: Multi-vehicle ops run over the engine. Start the multi-vehicle engine from the connection screen to take off and form up the whole fleet together. Single-vehicle commands stay on the bar below.
SimWorldView.dragToMoveMagnetsToPanel: Drag to move - magnets to panel & window edges
SimWorldView.perMotorOutputBarHeightThrottle: Per-motor output (bar height = throttle command, colour = arm load)
SimWorldView.airframeLoadFactorSpecificForceG: Airframe load factor (specific force / g). 1.0 in level hover; higher in pull-ups / hard turns
SimWorldView.worstPerArmBendingMomentThrust: Worst per-arm bending moment (thrust x arm length)
SimWorldView.airframeParasiticRotorMomentumDragOrange: Airframe parasitic + rotor momentum drag (orange arrow)
SimWorldView.netResultantForceAcceleratingTheAirframe: Net resultant force accelerating the airframe (white arrow); near zero in a steady hover

sim_test_conditions.disableGpsToTriggerTheGps: Disable GPS to trigger the GPS-loss failsafe / EKF fallback (SIM_GPS1_ENABLE 0)
sim_test_conditions.dropRcToTriggerTheRadio: Drop RC to trigger the radio failsafe (SIM_RC_FAIL 1)
